cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Carry the table with me, not for me. I'd like us to be partners today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can do it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. That's the arrangement I'm trying to stop calling our friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.

mechanism: A corrects its former lifting pupil helpful takeover into shared carrying and then shared decision-making, making the offer redefine them as partners.
confusable: Not refusing help to prove independence: A accepts the help but changes its form and uses that cooperation to claim equal say.
comparison: Physical assistance with joint destination versus writing assistance with joint authorship.
